claim: 你帶著幕僚的氣質，善於輔佐別人、重人和；能否保住自己的獨立，是你一生的分野。
en: You have the air of a trusted aide: good at supporting others and keeping the peace. Whether you keep your own independence is what shapes your life.

claim: 你的盤氣質偏優雅：你有自己的品味和立場，不失獨立；地位名聲往往勝一籌，命運卻未必因此更好。
en: Your chart leans refined: you have your own taste and stance and keep your independence; your standing tends to be higher, though your fortunes are not necessarily better for it.

claim: 你的盤偏隨俗：你善於適應環境，命運未必較差，但容易依附某個人或圈子。
en: Your chart leans conventional: you adapt well, and your fortunes are not necessarily worse, but you tend to attach yourself to a person or circle.
limit: 原文用語較重（官場附庸、庸常鄙陋），改寫為依附傾向。

claim: 你成見較深、主觀強。
en: Your views run deep and you are strongly opinionated.

claim: 你容易靠依附有力的人往上走。
en: You tend to rise by attaching yourself to people with influence.
limit: 原文：財蔭夾印的天相未必優雅，附庸登龍亦符合財蔭相夾之意。

claim: 你個性獨特，落落寡合，不肯隨波逐流。
en: You are your own person, somewhat aloof, and unwilling to drift with the crowd.
limit: 天同化忌與天梁同宮相鄰不算刑忌夾（p358.b004、p030.b010）；天梁化科、三方無煞、見吉兩粒以上可解（p030.b010）。

claim: 你的盤受刑忌所夾，是夾宮中最不利的一種，容易捲入是非。
en: Your chart has the most unfavourable kind of flanking, and you are easily drawn into disputes.
limit: 原文「主官司刑杖」，不寫。天同化忌與天梁同宮相鄰不算刑忌夾（p358.b004、p030.b010）；天梁化科、三方無煞、見吉兩粒以上可解（p030.b010）。

claim: 你的盤有財蔭相夾的好格局，是夾宮中最理想的一種。
en: Your chart has the wealth-and-shelter flanking, the most desirable kind.

claim: 你有輔佐大局的格局，能居於高位，但始終受上司牽制。
en: You have the pattern of a chief aide: you can reach high office, yet you remain checked by those above you.
limit: 原文：丑未天相喜百官朝拱，為宰輔之意，居一人之下萬人之上，唯終受上司掣肘。

claim: 你容易受是非困擾、勞碌奔波，事情常突生波折。
en: You are prone to disputes and running about, and things often hit sudden snags.

claim: 你身邊多有助力，是吉兆。
en: You have help close at hand, a good sign.

claim: 你雖有靠山，重要關頭卻往往借不上力，容易懷才不遇。
en: You have backers, yet at crucial moments their help often fails to arrive, and your talent can go unrecognised.
note: p358.b004：天同化忌同天梁同一邊夾，原文明講「雖不成刑忌夾印」。GEJU_DEF.xingji 已改用 jia sides，兩樣同一邊唔算，同本卡一致。

claim: 你雖借不上長輩的力，卻能得到朋友的支援。
en: Though you cannot lean on elders, friends come through for you.
note: 300 盤 0 次，2000 盤 17 次：庚年＋命宮丑未＋輔弼同度要特定時辰，真係罕見。

claim: 你聰明，卻容易懷才不遇。
en: You are clever, yet your talent easily goes unrecognised.
limit: 原文「見昌曲必須不見化忌及羊陀始吉，否則聰明而命薄」；古人「妾侍之命」不寫。

claim: 你容易因主觀成見而招來挫敗。
en: Your own fixed opinions can bring you setbacks.

claim: 你容易遇上賞識你的人。
en: You tend to meet people who appreciate you.

claim: 你的立場容易反覆，今天跟這邊、明天跟那邊。
en: Your allegiances shift easily, with one side today and another tomorrow.

claim: 你的財源較順遂。
en: Your income flows fairly smoothly.
limit: 原文最喜得其對宮武殺之祿。

claim: 你擅於靈活周旋、順勢而為，即使底子不厚也應付得來。
en: You are good at manoeuvring and going with the flow, and you manage even without much behind you.

claim: 你難得長輩做靠山，自己又不易獨立創業，容易懷才不遇。
en: You rarely find a senior to back you, yet striking out alone is hard too, so your talent may go unrecognised.

claim: {decades}這段時間，是你一生運程的關鍵，吉凶都來得特別明顯。
en: The years {decades} are the turning points of your life course, when good and bad both show sharply.

claim: {decades}這段時間，是你能否有收獲的重要關口。
en: The years {decades} are the key point for whether your efforts pay off.

claim: 這十年內心愉快，是好運。
en: This decade brings contentment; it is a good stretch.

claim: 這十年利於增長學養和人生經驗。
en: This decade is good for building knowledge and life experience.

claim: 這十年容易惹上桃花、風流自賞，影響後來的運勢。
en: This decade invites romantic distraction and self-indulgence, which can affect the years after.

claim: 這十年容易沉迷享樂。
en: This decade you are prone to losing yourself in pleasures.
limit: 原文「沉迷於酒色財氣之中」。

claim: 這十年對你最為不利。
en: This decade is the least favourable for you.

claim: 這一年你倚靠的人或機構容易失勢。
en: This year the people or institutions you rely on may lose their footing.
limit: 原文「傾敗之年，後台冰山倒去」。

claim: 這十年對你有利。
en: This decade works in your favour.

claim: 這十年得到的多是虛名虛利。
en: This decade brings mostly empty name and passing profit.

claim: 這十年要防受人排擠。
en: This decade, guard against being edged out.

claim: 這十年容易受所屬機構或上司的變動牽連。
en: This decade, upheaval at your workplace or among your superiors can drag you in.
limit: 原文「更嫌惡煞並臨宮限」：兩粒或以上煞；原條件多咗化忌。

claim: 這十年容易脫穎而出，受人賞識。
en: This decade you can stand out and win recognition.

claim: 這十年得不到有力的提拔。
en: This decade you do not get strong backing or promotion.

claim: 這十年容易因進反退、得而復失，也易受人埋怨牽連。
en: This decade, advancing may set you back and gains may slip away; you may also draw blame or get pulled into others' troubles.
limit: 原局刑忌夾印者原文主官非，不寫。

claim: 這十年可以掌握重權。
en: This decade you can hold real authority.
limit: 原文「見輔佐諸曜會合三方四正」：兩粒或以上。

claim: 這十年也覺得意，財喜不斷。
en: This decade also feels good, with steady gains and happy news.
limit: 原文「見輔佐諸曜會合三方四正」：兩粒或以上。

claim: 這十年宜退居閒處，反而容易遇上賞識你的人；四處活動反損名聲。
en: This decade, step back to quieter ground and you are more likely to be noticed; rushing about harms your name.
limit: 原文「多惡煞凶曜」：兩粒或以上煞。

claim: 這十年容易招惹惡性競爭和人身攻擊，愈想扭轉愈陷劣勢。
en: This decade draws cutthroat rivalry and personal attacks, and the harder you fight back the deeper you sink.
limit: 原文「多惡煞凶曜」：兩粒或以上煞。

claim: 這一年容易轉換跑道，改投更賞識你的人。
en: This year you may change course and move to someone who values you more.
limit: 原文「吉化見吉曜，主改投明主」。

claim: 這一年容易失去一直提攜你的人。
en: This year you may lose the person who has been backing you.

claim: 這一年往往會與人合作開創新事，也容易有感情上的困擾。
en: This year often brings a joint venture with others, and emotional troubles easily arise too.

claim: 這十年是重要的收獲期，機遇不錯。
en: This decade is an important harvest, with good openings.

claim: 這十年收獲較有限。
en: This decade brings more limited returns.

claim: 這十年容易有是非口舌。
en: This decade brings gossip and disputes.
limit: 原文「空露的府庫，會廉貞化忌，有煞耗刑曜同躔，則主有官非或口舌」，只寫口舌；耗曜引擎冇。空庫露庫屬待決事項，現照用。

claim: 這十年容易招惹是非埋怨，或因沉迷享樂而損失。
en: This decade invites disputes and resentment, or losses through indulgence.
limit: 原文「庸常的天相經行至此，更易招惹是非尤怨」，接空露府庫一句。空庫露庫屬待決事項，現照用。

claim: 這十年財祿如意，是吉運。
en: This decade money comes as you wish; a fortunate stretch.
limit: 原文「入廟的太陰見吉曜」：只計吉曜，不計吉化。

claim: 這十年財運不錯，只是稍遜一籌。
en: This decade money comes fairly well, if a step short of the best.
limit: 原文「入廟的太陰見吉曜」：只計吉曜，不計吉化。

claim: 這十年得財辛苦，但仍算好運。
en: This decade money is hard-won, but it is still a decent stretch.

claim: 這十年容易破財失意。
en: This decade brings losses and disappointment.

claim: 這十年是你得意之時。
en: This decade is a time when things go your way.

claim: 這十年多有好際遇，只是不耐久。
en: This decade brings good encounters, though they do not last.

claim: 這一年容易突然有所得。
en: This year may bring a sudden gain.
limit: 原文「若貪狼於大運化祿，於廉貪流年，見流祿同度，主是年突發」。流年祿存永遠唔會落巳亥流年命宮（巳亥年天干無丙戊壬），所以流祿取大限流祿為主。
note: 原條件只計流年流祿，盤面上不可能，加大限流祿。

claim: 這一年容易因感情糾葛而失足。
en: This year, romantic entanglement can lead you astray.
limit: 原文「桃花劫，更見刑煞，主因色傾敗」。

claim: 這十年吉慶順遂，對你的出身和人際影響深遠。
en: This decade is happy and smooth, with lasting effects on your start in life and your relationships.

claim: 這十年和家人關係容易冷淡疏離，人際上要多花心思。
en: This decade family ties can turn cold and distant; put extra care into your relationships.
limit: 原文「主六親冰炭」；此為天相坐命者的第二個大運。
